_doc: Organizer accounts read through Meta's official Instagram API (lib/instagram.js), when the IG_ACCESS_TOKEN secret exists. Business and creator accounts only; aggregators and personal accounts are left out. `venue` is where the account's own events are when a caption names no place.
_igUserId: @bryantakespictures, the business account the Business Discovery calls are made as (linked to the VTeam Volleyball Page). Not a secret; the token is the IG_ACCESS_TOKEN Actions secret.
_skip: Round-up and personal accounts, never promoted. Any other account the daily discovery credits with two or more events is read by rule from then on (public/data/event-accounts.json keeps the count).
